description: Frozen AMBI-XQC prior versus native inner XQC, borrowing only the J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512 rollout and update-slot budget from AMBITDMPC2-humanoid-walk-base-v2-d512-4-j6-seed55. XQC retains checkpoint architecture, normalization and optimizer semantics; policy delay three gives C18/A6/T6 per real decision.

budget_source.scope: Rollout and shared update-slot budgets only; this is native XQC, not SAC.

controller.description: Seed-paired persistent-prior and fresh action-local XQC episode returns with complete outer state frozen.

prior.description: Execute the persistent actor tanh mean with no imagined work; matching prior bundles from the MPPI comparison can be reused.

xqc.description: Execute the adapted actor tanh mean after J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512 native XQC: 9,216 model transitions, 18 critic steps and six accepted actor/temperature steps with checkpoint policy delay three. Inherit learning rates and reward normalization from the checkpoint.
